notes:
Lead source: inbound from sales enablement newsletter signup + trial signup. Product: call summarization (post-call notes, highlight extraction), real-time short summary snippets for SDR workflow.

Discovery notes:
- First intro call 2026-03-10 (Fireflies id ff_2026-03-10_4821). Quick demo of current system (Node-based server + AssemblyAI transcription).
- Wants hosted API self-serve: low friction onboarding, predictable per-call cost. Small team, wants simple billing and quick sandbox.
- Quote from CEO: "We need summaries that can be redacted for PII automatically; can't ship raw transcripts to external vendors."
- Concern: storing customer PII inside Redwood hosted storage. Asking about retention defaults, ability to purge, and data deletion APIs.
- Interested in token-level cost estimates (monthly avg 5k mins/month audio -> ~300k tokens?)
- Latency: not real-time streaming requirement for initial product; prefer end-of-call summary under 8s for 30-60s summaries.
- Throughput: peak 3-4 concurrent uploads during outbound cadence; typical concurrency low.
- Model preference: small-to-medium open models ok if quality is sufficient; they care about deterministic outputs for integrator UX.
- Routing/fallback: would like simple fallback to cheaper model on high load; need consistent summary schema (JSON highlights + TL;DR).
- Security: requires SSO for internal console; audit logs for each generated summary; retention controls per-customer; option to disable storing transcripts.
- Compliance: evaluating SOC2 readiness; customer-facing enterprise contracts may require data residency in US only.

POC / Technical checkpoints:
- POC goal: 2-week proof to integrate hosted API + sample retention config, run 2000 calls, verify deletion workflow.
- Tech lead: Head of Eng, Priya Rao (introduced on call). Follow-up for API keys and sample payloads.
- SE asked to provide: hosted API quickstart, sample deletion API call, retention policy examples, cost estimation worksheet. (See drive doc links above).

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-03-08: Trial signup via website, used free credits to test transcription endpoint.
- 2026-03-10: Intro call w/ Ava + Noah. Fireflies transcript + notes uploaded.
- 2026-03-11: Security questionnaire sent (light), they returned partial answers.
- 2026-03-12: Email thread started re: PII redaction approaches (thread r-1872938).
- 2026-03-14: SE call to propose retention options + pricing tiers.

Open questions / blockers to close:
- Does Redwood hosted API offer configurable auto-redaction or PII detection before storage? Need short doc.
- Can we commit to 30-day default retention and provide on-demand purge via API? Specific SLA around full deletion requested.
- Pricing sensitivity: need a break-even estimate for 50k summarized minutes/mo; show batching/optimize suggestions to reduce unit costs.

Next steps (short):
- Send security FAQ + sample GDPR/PII redaction patterns (Ava 03/14)
- Provision sandbox API key + 30-day credits (Noah)
- Schedule 30-min POC kick-off with Priya week of 03/23

Notes style: short, technical + business bullets. Customer seems conversion-ready if retention/PII answers are satisfactory.
